title: 第4章 秋衣与人心 逝去的少年
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第4章秋衣与人心逝去的少年
随着那一道光芒入目，陆景眼前骤然被黑暗笼罩。
可紧接着，他又看到那无边黑暗中，有一团火焰燃烧起来，灼灼其辉，耀眼至极。
在火焰之外，他隐约可见，一尊神明正悬浮在黑暗里，若隐若现。
“大明王焱天大圣观想图！”
一种种意念袭来。
陆景脑海中不过浮现了那光团片刻光景，甚至还不曾细致的看到那光团究竟是什么东西。
他只觉得一阵晕眩，口干舌燥，胸中好像是被什么堵住了，直想要呕吐也许只过了几息时间，也许过了很久，陆景猛然回过神，大口大口喘息起来。
又有一阵风吹过，刺骨的凉意传来，陆景才发现冷汗已经浸透了他身上的长衣！
“这幅画，竟然是一幅观想宝图！”
陆景看着桌上的图画，喘息间怔然片刻，又连忙闭起眼睛，意念集中在脑海中那观象境上。
观相八卦图浮现于脑海中，内象再度显现。
陆景逐行看去，终于发现了一项变动。
“机缘那一栏中，原本是【蓝色机缘正在触发】，如今赫然显示着【机缘：大明王焱天大圣观想图已触发】。”
“这代表那蓝色色机缘已经被触发了！”
陆景看着眼前的观想图，心中不无喜悦，可猛然间，他又似乎想到了什么，不动声色间，就已经将那一幅观想图叠好放入怀中。
“无论如何，这一幅观想图都应该是一件宝物，这里并不是研究它的好地方。”
陆景站起身来，又有一股晕眩向他袭来，他险些都站不稳了，踉跄两下，又仓惶坐在石凳上。
“我刚刚不过看了几眼这神明图，观想的时间甚至不足一息时间，精神便亏空的厉害……”
陆景休息了好一阵，这才奋力起身，缓缓走向自己的小院。

陆景的居所坐落在陆府的西北角落，距离方才那石桌石凳其实不远。
可平日里只需要走盏茶的路程，陆景硬是走了一刻钟。
“景少爷，你回来……呀！少爷，你的脸色怎么这般差了？今日中午还好好的。”
陆景入院，走入前屋，青玥正巧在前屋桌前摆放碗筷，见到陆景回来明显一喜。
随着陆景走近，原本就不太明亮的蜡烛映照下，陆景一张蜡黄、萎靡不堪的脸落入青玥眼帘。
青玥连忙过来扶陆景坐下，又去里屋拿了一件长衣为陆景披上。
陆景真的感觉有点冷，但他并不想让青玥担心，便打起精神，提起语调，对青玥道：“你不用担心，今日突然起了风，我受了些凉而已，明日出了太阳晒上一晒也就好了……”
“少爷染了风寒？”青玥如临大敌，她顾不得桌上的饭食，便要提着灯笼出门。
“我这就去找那刘管事，找几方药回来。”
陆景连忙让青玥坐下，安抚道：“青玥，小题大做了，房里黑漆麻乌的，照得我的脸色差了些，其实没事的，伱大晚上去扰刘管事的清梦，免不了要受委屈。”
“不是风寒？”青玥仍然担忧道：“我受些委屈又值当什么？少爷，风寒可是会要人命的！”
“如今又不是严冬，哪有那么容易生寒病？”陆景指了指桌上几本书，道：“不过是今日读了太久的书，有些累了而已。”
他说到这里，见青玥表情终于没有那么凝重了，这才转移话题，深深的嗅了一口，看着桌上的饭食惊奇道：“嗯？这是羊肉？”
青玥连忙将筷子顺好，又为陆景夹了一块羊肉。
“这肉是二府烽大少爷院里的丫头送来的，据说二府烽少爷习武有了大进境，阖府所有人，不论少爷小姐，丫鬟下人都有赏赐。”
“习武有了进境？”陆景心里不由十分羡慕。
他穿越到这个奇怪的世界，一来就上了赘婿贱籍，科举几乎已经无望，就只能从其他方面寻找可能，改变这憋屈的命运。
现在他得到了大明王观想图，可是对于如果使用这观想图、观想图究竟有什么作用，都是一头雾水，更没有人教他习武。
“能让陆烽这么高兴，阖府庆祝，看来确实是大进境。”
陆景思绪纷飞，一旁的青玥一边为陆景倒水，一边道：“今天下午，我还去领了少爷的秋服。”

“真是可气，陆家大府两位少爷，两位小姐，其它少爷小姐的秋服都极好，连料子都是江南道桑槐府出产的名贵温丝，又薄又暖，只有我们院子里……”
青玥本来在小声嘟囔，眼神温柔，似乎是为陆景不值。
大概是觉得这时不该说这些话，让陆景平白心烦，她又停下话语，起身想要出门。
陆景皱了皱眉，青玥解释道：“少爷，我再去多为你烧一壶水，你好好泡一泡脚，兴许明天身体便会好上许多。”
早先的陆景原身也许已经对青玥无微不至的照顾习以为常。
可现在的陆景却由衷觉得，能够有青玥这么一个温柔的人陪在他身边，是他的幸事。
于是陆景并不拒绝青玥，只是心中却暗下决定……
“总要把这生活经营的更加好上一些，否则其他不论，到对不起青玥了。”
陆景吃过饭，青玥又帮她泡脚、揉洗，足足忙到了子时，青玥才离开里屋，休息去了。
眼见青玥走了，陆景又下床点燃蜡烛，拿出那大明王神明图，细细观看。
但因有前车之鉴，陆景并未再次专注的闭目观想，而是找来纸笔，一笔一划临摹着画中的大明王焱天大圣。
“我的血气并不旺盛，精神也无法支撑我观想大明王神明图。
这样一来，便是白白浪费了这样的奇物……看来我往后不能专注于读书，也要锻炼体魄，温养精神……只是，这谈何容易。”
锻炼体魄、温养精神。
不论是哪一项计划，陆景都没有什么头绪。
此生不论温养精神的难处，光是想要锻炼体魄，满足习武的标准，就需要消耗大量的食物、药材。
可是陆景的月钱，每个月不过三两银子，还要被府中的管事用种种名义，盘剥走一两，到手的不过二两钱财。
“区区二两银子，又谈何炼体、习武？”
陆景想到这里，不由摇了摇头。
可他并不觉得伤神，他心性豁达，也知道这样的事自然要从长计议，慢慢等待机会。

于是在他临摹了足足三遍大明王神明图之后，又将神明图贴身收好，安详睡去。
当他熟睡之际，枕头底下的大明王神明图却突然发出微微亮光。
一道道模糊的记忆便如同梦境一般，纷纷而来。
陆景身在梦境之中，隐隐约约看到了很多过往的事。
——“景儿，你这眉眼，像极了你的父亲，你快快长大，长大之后，也会成为你父亲那样的英豪。”
一位眉目如画，神色慈爱温柔的妇人，正坐在一艘画舫上，受着几个男女的冷眼，逗弄着怀中的婴儿。
——“娘~娘~”
“不能哭，景儿，爬起来，咳咳……”
——“娘，他们都说我没爹教，都说我是野种，什么是野种？”
——“咳……景儿，不是为娘不愿意给你买新衣服，是旧衣服更好穿一些，你看？”
“哇，破洞不见了，多了一头小老虎，真神气，娘可真厉害！”
——“景儿，莫哭，谁说你无父？咳咳咳……我这就带你去见你的父亲……
这许多记忆画面萦绕在陆景的梦境里。
最终一幕幕记忆画卷融合在一起，逐渐化为一位少年。
那少年躯体发着微光，居高临下的注视着陆景。
陆景似有所觉，他睁开眼睛，站起身来，也望着那发光的少年。
少年与他模样一般无二，向陆景行礼。
“我既已轻生，便不该赖在这躯体里。
而我这一生，最对不起的便是我的生母。
今日我愿意以魂魄为酬，用这躯体为礼，劳烦……劳烦兄长为我的亡母争一个诰命，争一个凤冠霞披葬入棺中。

让知道她名姓的世人，不至于因为她的出身而看轻了她！”
那少年说罢，还不等陆景反应，倏忽间就化为一道流光，冲入陆景的眉心。
也许是因为这躯体本来就与少年魂灵相契合。
也许还有其他原因。
流光入体的那一刹那，陆景只觉得自己的疲惫一扫而空，精神也变得清明无比。
脑海中种种思绪渐渐清晰。
他意识到……自己体内某种力量因为少年魂灵的缘故，猛然间壮大、壮大！
陆景坐在床榻上许久，记忆融合之下，他突然非常思念那真正意义上，从未与他谋面的，这具身体的母亲。
“这算是什么交易？没有给我拒绝的机会啊……”
深吸一口气，陆景好像是在自言自语道：“你放心，这买卖，我应下了。”
content_en:
Chapter 4 Qiu Yi and the young man who lost his heart
As that ray of light entered Lu Jing's eyes, his eyes were suddenly shrouded in darkness.
But then, he saw a flame burning in the boundless darkness, burning brightly and dazzlingly.
Outside the flames, he could vaguely see a god suspended in the darkness, looming.
"Visualization Picture of Great Sage Yantian, King of Ming Dynasty!"
All kinds of thoughts came over me.
Lu Jing only had the sight of the light group in his mind for a moment, and he hadn't even seen in detail what the light group was.
He just felt dizzy, his mouth was dry, and his chest seemed to be blocked by something. He wanted to vomit. Maybe it only took a few breaths, maybe it took a long time. Lu Jing suddenly came to his senses and started breathing heavily.
Another gust of wind blew by, bringing a biting chill. Only then did Lu Jing realize that cold sweat had soaked through his long clothes!
"This painting is actually a treasure map of visualization!"
Lu Jing looked at the pictures on the table, gasping for breath for a moment, then quickly closed his eyes and concentrated on the visual realm in his mind.
The Eight Diagrams diagram of observing the appearance appears in the mind, and the inner image appears again.
Lu Jing looked at it line by line and finally discovered a change.
"In the opportunity column, it originally read [Blue opportunity is being triggered], but now it clearly shows [Opportunity: The visualization chart of Great Sage Yantian of the Ming Dynasty has been triggered]."
"This means that the blue opportunity has been triggered!"
Lu Jing looked at the visualization picture in front of him with joy in his heart. But suddenly, he seemed to have thought of something. Without a word, he folded the visualization picture and put it in his arms.
"No matter what, this visualization picture should be a treasure, and this is not a good place to study it."
Lu Jing stood up, and another wave of dizziness hit him. He almost lost his balance, staggered twice, and sat down on the stone bench in panic.
"I just took a few glances at this picture of the gods, and the time I spent contemplating it was less than one breath, and my energy was so low..."
Lu Jing rested for a while, then stood up and walked slowly towards his small courtyard.
Lu Jing's residence is located in the northwest corner of Lu Mansion, not far from the stone table and bench just now.
But usually it only takes a cup of tea, but Lu Jing walked for a quarter of an hour.
"Master Jing, come back...ah! Master, why does your face look so bad? You were fine at noon today."
Lu Jing was admitted to the hospital and walked into the front room. Qing Yue happened to be placing dishes and chopsticks in front of the table in the front room. She was obviously happy to see Lu Jing back.
As Lu Jing approached, Lu Jing's sallow, depressed face fell into Qing Yue's eyes under the light of the candle, which was not very bright.
Qing Yue hurriedly came over to help Lu Jing sit down, and then went to the back room to get a long coat and put it on Lu Jing.
Lu Jing really felt a little cold, but he didn't want Qing Yue to worry, so he cheered up, raised his tone, and said to Qing Yue: "Don't worry, the wind suddenly started blowing today, I just suffered a little cold, it will be fine if the sun comes out tomorrow..."
"Young Master has caught the cold?" Qing Yue felt like she was facing a powerful enemy. She didn't care about the food on the table, so she had to go out with a lantern.
"I'm going to go find Manager Liu and bring back some prescription medicine."
Lu Jing quickly asked Qing Yue to sit down and comforted him: "Qing Yue, you're making a fuss out of a molehill. The room is so dark that it makes my face look a little worse. Actually, it's okay. I'm going to disturb Manager Liu's dream at night, so I'm bound to be wronged."
"Isn't it Feng Han?" Qing Yue was still worried: "What do I deserve if I suffer some grievances? Young Master, Feng Han can kill people!"
"It's not a severe winter, so how can we easily get cold illnesses?" Lu Jing pointed to a few books on the table and said, "It's just that I've been reading for too long today, so I'm a little tired."
When he said this, he saw that Qing Yue's expression was finally not so solemn, so he changed the subject, took a deep sniff, looked at the food on the table and said in surprise: "Huh? Is this mutton?"
Qingyue hurriedlyHe smoothed his chopsticks and picked up another piece of mutton for Lu Jing.
"This meat was sent by the maid from the courtyard of Master Feng of the Second Prefecture. It is said that Master Feng of the Second Prefecture has made great progress in martial arts. Everyone in the house, regardless of the young master, young lady, maids and servants, will be rewarded."
"Wushu practice has entered the country?" Lu Jing couldn't help but feel envious.
He traveled to this strange world, and became a son-in-law and a lowly citizen as soon as he arrived. The imperial examination was almost hopeless, so he could only look for possibilities in other aspects to change this frustrating fate.
Now he has obtained the visualization diagram of the Ming Dynasty King, but he is completely confused about how to use this visualization diagram and its function, and no one has taught him how to practice martial arts.
"To make Lu Feng so happy and celebrate with the whole family, it seems that it is indeed a great achievement."
Lu Jing's thoughts were racing, and Qing Yue on the side poured water for Lu Jing and said, "This afternoon, I also went to pick up the young master's autumn clothes."
"It's really annoying. The autumn clothes of the two young masters, two young ladies, and other young masters and ladies of the Lu family are all very good. Even the materials are made of precious warm silk produced in Sanghuai Mansion, Jiangnan Road. It is thin and warm. Only in our yard..."
Qing Yue was muttering softly, with gentle eyes, as if she was not worth it for Lu Jing.
Probably because she felt that she shouldn't say these words at this time, which made Lu Jingping upset, she stopped talking again, stood up and wanted to go out.
Lu Jing frowned, and Qing Yue explained: "Master, I will boil an extra pot of water for you. You can take a good soak in your feet. Maybe your health will be much better tomorrow."
Earlier, Lu Jingyuan might have been accustomed to Qing Yue's meticulous care.
But now Lu Jing sincerely feels that he is lucky to have such a gentle person like Qing Yue by his side.
So Lu Jing did not reject Qing Yue, but he made a secret decision in his heart...
"You must manage your life better, otherwise you will be sorry for Qing Yue if you don't care about anything else."
After Lu Jing had eaten, Qing Yue helped her soak and wash her feet. It was only around midnight that Qing Yue left the back room to rest.
Seeing Qing Yue gone, Lu Jing got out of bed and lit the candle, took out the picture of the Ming King and looked at it carefully.
But because he had learned from the past, Lu Jing did not close his eyes and meditate again. Instead, he found a pen and paper and copied the Ming Dynasty King Yantian in the painting stroke by stroke.
“My blood is not strong, and my energy cannot support me in visualizing the Divine Map of the Great Ming King.
In this way, such a rare thing is wasted... It seems that I can't focus on studying in the future, but also need to exercise my body and warm my spirit... But this is not easy. "
Exercise the body and warm the spirit.
No matter which plan it was, Lu Jing had no clue.
Regardless of the difficulty of nourishing the spirit in this life, just to train the body and meet the standards for martial arts requires consuming a lot of food and medicinal materials.
However, Lu Jing's monthly money was only three taels of silver each month, and the stewards in the mansion would use various excuses to extort one tael away, and all he got was only two taels of money.
"With just two taels of silver, how can we talk about practicing physical training and martial arts?"
Lu Jing couldn't help but shook his head when he thought of this.
But he didn't feel nervous. He was open-minded and knew that such a matter should be considered in the long term and wait for the opportunity slowly.
So after he copied the painting of the gods of King Ming Dynasty three times, he put the painting of gods close to his body and fell asleep peacefully.
While he was sleeping soundly, the picture of the Great Ming King under his pillow suddenly glowed slightly.
One after another, vague memories came one after another like a dream.
Lu Jing was in a dream and vaguely saw many things in the past.
——"Jing'er, your facial features are very much like your father's. You grow up quickly and you will become a hero like your father when you grow up."
A woman with picturesque features and a loving and gentle look was sitting on a boat, teasing the baby in her arms while receiving cold looks from several men and women.
——"Mother~mother~"
"Don't cry, Jing'er, get up,Ahem..."
——"Mom, they all say that I have no father's teachings and that I am a bastard. What is a bastard? "
——"Ahem... Jing'er, it's not because mother doesn't want to buy you new clothes, it's because old clothes are more wearable, you see?" "
"Wow, the hole is gone, and there is a little tiger. It's so cool, my mother is so awesome! "
——"Jing'er, don't cry, who said you have no father? Cough cough cough...I'll take you to see your father right now...
These many memory scenes linger in Lu Jing's dreams.
In the end, the memory scrolls merged together and gradually transformed into a young man.
The young man's body shimmered and he stared down at Lu Jing.
Lu Jing seemed to realize something. He opened his eyes, stood up, and looked at the shining boy.
The young man looked just like him and saluted Lu Jing.
"Since I committed suicide, I should not remain in this body.
And the person I feel most sorry for in my life is my biological mother.
Today I am willing to use my soul as a reward and this body as a gift. Please...please brother, I will fight for a royal title for my deceased mother and a phoenix crown to bury her in the coffin.
Let the world who know her name not look down upon her because of her origin! "
After the young man said this, before Lu Jing could react, he suddenly turned into a stream of light and rushed into Lu Jing's eyebrows.
Perhaps it was because this body was originally in tune with the young soul.
Maybe there are other reasons.
The moment the light entered his body, Lu Jing felt that his fatigue was swept away and his spirit became extremely clear.
All the thoughts in my mind gradually became clear.
He realized... that some kind of power in his body suddenly grew stronger and stronger because of the young man's soul!
Lu Jing sat on the bed for a long time. As his memories merged, he suddenly missed his mother in this body, whom he had never met in the true sense.
"What kind of deal is this? You didn't give me a chance to refuse..."
Taking a deep breath, Lu Jing seemed to be talking to himself: "Don't worry, I will accept this deal."
